_note: v2.5 plan 09 SP2 R4 (and R5's spike arm), LIVE on the dev build, spike flag ON. Same editor leg as R1: the request after the edit must carry the vault marker only. Then a recast-style leg: chat[id].mes is rewritten twice, each followed by MESSAGE_EDITED alone (a post-processor's per-rewrite events), so that the door swings open; the next request must carry the open marker only. Reads between each edit and the next send are R5's spike column (reason recommit:<id> is the spike's own read). J6 runs x2 separately with the flag on (see the SP2 report).

steps.eval: const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; if (!ctx.groupId || !ctx.chatId) throw new Error('needs a group chat (so-scenario --sandbox --group <id>)'); if (!globalThis.storyOrchestratorSpikes?.recommitEdit) throw new Error('the SP2 spike module is not loaded: serve the dev build (npm run build:dev && npm run serve:dev)'); for (const key of Object.keys(globalThis).filter((k) => k.startsWith('storyOrchestratorDebug'))) delete globalThis[key]; const settings = ctx.extensionSettings['story-orchestrator']?.settings; if (!settings) throw new Error('no settings root'); const before = settings.spikes ? { ...settings.spikes } : null; settings.spikes = { ...(settings.spikes ?? {}), recommitEdit: true }; ctx.saveSettingsDebounced(); if (rt.getGlobalSettings().spikes?.recommitEdit !== true) throw new Error('the spike flag did not land'); if (globalThis.__sp2?.onSent) ctx.eventSource.removeListener(ctx.eventTypes.GENERATE_AFTER_DATA, globalThis.__sp2.onSent); globalThis.__sp2 = { before, flag: true, sent: [], edits: [], mark: 0 }; globalThis.__sp2.onSent = (data, dryRun) => { if (dryRun) return; globalThis.__sp2.sent.push({ at: Date.now(), active: rt.getEngineState()?.activeCheckpointId ?? null, prompt: typeof data?.prompt === 'string' ? data.prompt : JSON.stringify(data?.messages ?? data ?? null) }); }; ctx.eventSource.on(ctx.eventTypes.GENERATE_AFTER_DATA, globalThis.__sp2.onSent); const read = rt.getGlobalSettings(); return { flag: true, before, cadence: read.extraction.cadence, judge: read.judge.enabled };

send_generate.text: I nod to Ponticius and ask what the guild needs from me.

steps.eval: const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const id = ctx.chat.length - 1; const row = ctx.chat[id]; if (!row || row.is_user || row.is_system) throw new Error('the newest message is not a reply'); const state = rt.getEngineState(); if (state.lastMessageId !== id) throw new Error('the newest reply is not the newest committed message: engine last ' + state.lastMessageId + ', reply ' + id); if (state.activeCheckpointId !== 'hall') throw new Error('expected hall before the edit, got ' + state.activeCheckpointId); const edit = { leg: 'editor', id, at: Date.now(), active: state.activeCheckpointId, stats: globalThis.storyOrchestratorSpikes.recommitEdit.stats() }; globalThis.__sp2.edits.push(edit); const texts = ["Ponticius unhooks the brass vault key from his belt and presses it into your hand. \"Keep it safe,\" he says."]; const events = ["MESSAGE_EDITED", "MESSAGE_UPDATED"]; for (const text of texts) { row.mes = text; if (Array.isArray(row.swipes)) row.swipes[row.swipe_id ?? 0] = text; ctx.updateMessageBlock?.(id, row); for (const name of events) await ctx.eventSource.emit(ctx.eventTypes[name], id); } await ctx.saveChat(); return edit;

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const edit = globalThis.__sp2.edits[globalThis.__sp2.edits.length - 1]; edit.reads = rt.getExtractionAudits().filter((audit) => Date.parse(audit.createdAt) >= edit.at).map((audit) => ({ reason: audit.reason, window: audit.window })); edit.after = { active: rt.getEngineState().activeCheckpointId, stats: globalThis.storyOrchestratorSpikes.recommitEdit.stats() }; globalThis.__sp2.mark = Date.now(); return edit;

send_generate.text: I close my fingers around whatever I am holding and look toward the vault.

steps.eval: const s = globalThis.__sp2; const edit = s.edits[s.edits.length - 1]; const request = s.sent.find((entry) => entry.at >= s.mark); if (!request) throw new Error('no request was captured after the edit'); const markers = ['HALL', 'VAULT', 'OPEN'].filter((name) => request.prompt.includes('[SO-SP2-' + name + ']')); const got = { leg: edit.leg, flag: s.flag, activeAtRequest: request.active, markers, reads: edit.reads, before: edit.stats, after: edit.after }; edit.request = got; if (markers.length !== 1 || markers[0] !== 'VAULT') throw new Error('R4 editor: the request after the edit carries ' + JSON.stringify(markers) + ', expected only VAULT :: ' + JSON.stringify(got)); return got;

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const id = ctx.chat.length - 1; const row = ctx.chat[id]; if (!row || row.is_user || row.is_system) throw new Error('the newest message is not a reply'); const state = rt.getEngineState(); if (state.lastMessageId !== id) throw new Error('the newest reply is not the newest committed message: engine last ' + state.lastMessageId + ', reply ' + id); if (state.activeCheckpointId !== 'vault') throw new Error('expected vault before the edit, got ' + state.activeCheckpointId); const edit = { leg: 'recast', id, at: Date.now(), active: state.activeCheckpointId, stats: globalThis.storyOrchestratorSpikes.recommitEdit.stats() }; globalThis.__sp2.edits.push(edit); const texts = ["Ponticius sets his shoulder to the vault door", "Ponticius sets his shoulder to the vault door and it swings open with a groan, the dark vault gaping before you."]; const events = ["MESSAGE_EDITED"]; for (const text of texts) { row.mes = text; if (Array.isArray(row.swipes)) row.swipes[row.swipe_id ?? 0] = text; ctx.updateMessageBlock?.(id, row); for (const name of events) await ctx.eventSource.emit(ctx.eventTypes[name], id); } await ctx.saveChat(); return edit;
